recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast 1960s-inspired layout featuring a central group photograph of a band in matching pinstripe suits interacting with an ice cream cart, framed by oversized, distorted psychedelic bubble lettering in vibrant pink, green, and black.
coreVisualRelationships: Large-scale typography acts as a structural frame for the central photography
High-saturation color blocks contrast with the naturalistic tones of the photo
The ice cream cart serves as a secondary focal point and prop for the subjects
Negative space is filled with dense, small-scale metadata text on the right
coreInvariants: Matching pinstripe blue suits on subjects
Bright pink and lime green color palette
Outdoor daylight setting with hard shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Band members are clustered in the lower-right quadrant, scaled to fit within the typographic frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, pink bubble letters in the top-left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the large pink title, down the green vertical lettering, across to the band members, and finally to the small tracklist on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is packed with text and imagery, using the sky as a backdrop for the black lettering.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Lime Green for vertical secondary title.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Sky Blue from the band's suits and the actual sky.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in graphic elements versus mid-tone naturalism in the photograph.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon; stick to 1960s saturated inks
Black used for heavy outlines and solid fills

letterConstructionRules: Letters must appear inflated and squeezed together
Counters are minimized to small slits or circles
Outer edges follow a wavy, organic path
Consistent heavy black stroke or solid fill
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'O' is rendered as a solid block with a tiny circular counter
Vertical letters are stretched and curved to fit the left margin
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between massive, distorted display lettering and tiny, rigid functional sans-serif.

preserve: The pinstripe texture of the clothing
avoid: Clean, undistorted fonts for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Suitable for the small metadata text blocks

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of four men in 1960s blue pinstripe suits posing playfully around a vintage ice cream push-cart on a sunny street. Leave the top and left edges clear for heavy graphic overlays.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply massive, distorted bubble lettering in magenta and lime green along the top and left edges. Add a block of small, right-aligned black sans-serif text in the upper right quadrant.

verificationChecks: Is the main title text distorted into organic, liquid shapes?
Do the subjects wear matching pinstripe suits?
Is the color palette limited to magenta, lime green, blue, and black?
Is the ice cream cart visible and integrated into the band's pose?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the liquid warp on the lettering
Specific colors of the bubble letters
Number of band members in the photo
Density of the metadata text block
mustRedesign: Specific band names and song titles

avoid: Modern sans-serif fonts for the title

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text does not obscure the faces of the subjects.
Ensure the pinstripe pattern on the suits is clearly visible.
Verify the 'ice cream' text on the cart is in a playful, matching style.
Confirm the background sky is a flat or slightly textured blue.
recipe.reuseFormula: Psychedelic Frame + Mod Photography + High-Contrast Color Blocking
